s.n: Soup kitchen beef and barley soup with crusty bread
s.note: Beef chuck slow-cooked with pearl barley. Gilbert says the world needs a wake-up call.
s.how: Brown the beef in the oil in batches and lift it out. Soften the onion, carrot, celery and garlic, then stir in the tomato paste. Return the beef, add the barley, stock and bay leaves and simmer gently, half covered, until the beef is tender. Season well and serve with thick slices of the loaf.

s.n: Building site egg and bacon rolls
s.note: Fried egg and bacon on a soft roll. Frank brings Nada his paycheque.
s.how: Fry the bacon until the edges crisp. Fry the eggs in the bacon fat until the whites set. Butter the rolls, add the bacon, egg and a good squirt of barbecue sauce.

m.n: Consume meatloaf with mash and onion gravy
m.note: Glazed beef meatloaf on buttery mash. Under the glasses the sign says CONSUME.
m.how: Mix the mince, grated onion, egg, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire and half the tomato sauce, and press into a loaf tin. Stir the rest of the tomato sauce with the sugar, spread it on top and bake at 180C until cooked through. Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with half the butter and the milk. Cook the sliced onions in the rest of the butter until brown, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and simmer to a gravy. Rest the meatloaf, slice thickly and serve on the mash with the gravy.

m.n: Back alley chilli con carne with cornbread
m.note: Smoky beef chilli with hot cornbread. Glasses on or start eating that trash can.
m.how: Brown the mince in the oil, then add the onion and garlic and cook until soft. Stir in the spices, then the tomatoes and beans, and simmer gently until thick and dark. Mix the polenta, flour, buttermilk, egg and melted butter, pour into a hot greased pan and bake at 200C until risen and golden. Serve the chilli with cheddar on top and wedges of cornbread.

w.n: All out of bubble gum ice cream sundaes
w.note: Pink bubble gum ice cream and hot fudge. Nada is all out of bubble gum.
w.how: Heat the cream and golden syrup, pour over the chocolate and stir until smooth. Scoop the ice cream into tall glasses. Pour over the hot fudge, add whipped cream, sprinkles and a cherry.

d.note: A shot of rye dropped in a cold lager. Frank's steel mill went under.
d.how: Pour the lager into 4 chilled glasses. Serve each with a 30ml shot of rye to drop in or sip alongside.
